youtube_short.title: Wrong 529 Plan Costs You $23,000
title_alternatives: The 529 Fee Trap Nobody Warns Parents About
You Can Use ANY State's 529 — Here's Why It Matters
youtube_short.description: Most parents open their home state's 529 and never think about it again. But 16 states run plans so expensive that the fee difference alone costs you $23,000 over 18 years. The wild part — you can open any state's 529 from anywhere in the country. Utah's my529 charges 0.05%. Some states charge 0.93%. That's 19 times higher for the exact same money. Google your state's 529 expense ratio and switch if it's above 0.3%. #529plan #collegesavings #personalfinance #moneyhacks #investingtips
